name: Nintendo 64
significance: Standardized the analog thumbstick, four integrated controller ports for local multiplayer, and established the grammar of spatial 3D game design.

editorialContent.overview: Silicon Graphics coprocessor powerhouse that established 360-degree analog control and foundational 3D spatial navigation.
